title: Sample Preparation Protocol for Targeted Mass Spectrometry Analysis of pRabs and LRRK2
author: Raja S. Nirujogi

steps.title: Tissue Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare pulverized mouse tissue for lysis.

substeps.instruction: Snap freeze mouse tissue immediately after isolation in liquid nitrogen and store at -80 °C.
Pulverize frozen tissue to a fine powder using a cell crusher kit in liquid nitrogen, maintaining all pulverizer units and spatulas in liquid nitrogen.
Wash the pulverizer with tap water and clean thoroughly several times with 70% (v/v) ethanol.
Weigh the pulverized tissue powder on a balance (keeping samples on dry ice), using a pre-chilled fine spatula and a tared 1.5 ml tube.

steps.title: Tissue Lysis and Clarification
steps.instruction: Lyse the tissue and clarify the resulting lysate.

substeps.instruction: Immediately add 2 Mass Percent SDS lysis buffer at 10X the weight of the tissue (e.g., 1000 µL buffer for 100 mg tissue powder).
Agitate samples on an orbital shaker in the cold room at 1000 rpm for 15 minutes.
Boil samples at 95 °C for 10 minutes and allow to cool.
Sonicate samples using a Diagenode Bioruptor at high energy for 10 cycles (30 seconds ON / 30 seconds OFF).
Clarify lysate by centrifuging at 20800 rpm at 4 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Cell Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare lysate from cell cultures (e.g., A549, HEK293, or MEFs).

substeps.instruction: Culture cells in 6cm or 10cm dishes to ~70% confluency and perform treatments (e.g., MLi2 treatment for 1.5 hours).
Harvest cells by washing with 1X plain DMEM media (no serum) and aspirating the media completely.
Lyse cells using 1% Triton-X 100 lysis buffer (add 150 µL for 6cm dish or 350 µL for 10cm dish).
Scrape cells with a cell scraper and collect lysate using 1 ml non-autoclaved tips into protein low-binding tubes.
Keep cells on ice for 30 minutes and centrifuge at 18000 x g at 4 °C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Protein Quantification and Aliquoting
steps.instruction: Quantify protein levels and prepare the amount required for mass spectrometry.

substeps.instruction: Measure protein amount using the Bicinchoninic acid assay (BCA) method in triplicate at 1:10 and 1:20 dilutions.
For mouse brain tissues, a minimum lysate amount of 1 mg is recommended to identify pRab proteins and LRRK2 pS910/pS935 and total LRRK2 peptide.
Aliquot 300 µg of protein (from either cell or tissue lysate) into 1.5 ml protein low-binding tubes.

steps.title: Protein Reduction and Alkylation
steps.instruction: Reduce and alkylate the protein samples.

substeps.instruction: Perform reduction by adding a 1:10 dilution of 0.1 M TCEP dissolved in 300 mM TEABC to reach a final TCEP concentration of 10 mM.
Incubate on a Thermomixer with gentle agitation at 1000 rpm, 60 °C, for 30 minutes.
Bring tubes to room temperature, then add a 1:10 dilution of freshly prepared 0.4 M iodoacetamide dissolved in water.
Incubate in the dark on a Thermomixer with gentle agitation at 1000 rpm at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Quench alkylation by adding a 1:10 dilution of 0.1 M TCEP dissolved in 300 mM TEABC to reach a final TCEP concentration of 10 mM.
Incubate on a Thermomixer with gentle agitation at 1000 rpm at room temperature for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Sample Denaturation and S-Trap Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample for S-Trap column processing.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 Mass Percent SDS stock to reach a final SDS concentration of 5 Mass Percent (supplementing the existing 2% SDS in tissue lysates or adding to 1% Triton-X 100 cell lysates).
Add a 1:10 dilution of 12% volume phosphoric acid to achieve a final concentration of ~1.2% volume (e.g., 5 µL into 50 µL).
Dilute the sample 7 times in S-Trap wash buffer (90% volume methanol in 0.1 M TEAB pH 7.1 v/v). For 50 µL of sample, add 300 µL buffer; scale accordingly for larger volumes.
Prepare an S-Trap mini column in a 2 ml tube and add the diluted protein mixture.

steps.title: S-Trap Protein Capture and Washing
steps.instruction: Capture proteins on the S-Trap column and remove detergents.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge briefly at 1000 x g at room temperature for 1 minute. If clogging occurs, increase speed up to 4,000g or time to 2-4 minutes. If total volume >500 µl, apply the sample multiple times.
Wash the column 4 times with 400 µL S-Trap buffer, centrifuging at 1000 x g for 1 minute between each wash.

steps.title: Tryptic Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest the captured proteins using trypsin.

substeps.instruction: Move the S-Trap column to a clean 2 ml tube.
Add 160 µL of freshly dissolved trypsin solution (15 µg trypsin in 100 mM TEAB, 1:20 dilution).
Centrifuge briefly at 200 x g for 1 minute.
Collect the flow-through and reapply the trypsin solution to the column, avoiding air bubbles.
Cap tubes and incubate at 47 °C without shaking for 1.5 hours.
Incubate for an additional 2 hours at room temperature.

steps.title: Peptide Elution and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Elute peptides and verify digestion efficiency.

substeps.instruction: Elute peptides by sequentially adding and spinning down the following into a new 'eluate tube': 80 µL 50 mM TEAB, 80 µL 0.15% (vol) Formic Acid, and 80 µL 50% (vol) Acetonitrile in 0.15% (vol) formic acid.
Vacuum dry 1-2 µL of the combined eluate and inject on MS (QE HF-X or Orbitrap Lumos, F1-T-FT-HCD mode, 70 min gradient).
Analyze data with Proteome Discoverer 2.1 or 2.4; digestion is efficient if zero missed cleavages >75% and single missed cleavages are 20-23%.

steps.title: Peptide Quantification and Aliquoting
steps.instruction: Quantify peptides and prepare aliquots for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Estimate peptide amounts using CBQCA assay kit.
Vacuum dry equal amounts of peptide digest using SpeedVac.
Aliquot 5 µg of peptide digest separately for total Rab analysis.

steps.title: Antibody Slurry Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the Protein A/G antibody cocktail slurry.

substeps.instruction: Wash Protein A/G beads with 1 mL 1X PBS (slurry volume + remainder). Centrifuge at 2000 x g for 3 minutes, let settle for 2 minutes, and aspirate.
Repeat the 1 mL 1X PBS wash two more times.
Incubate an equimolar concentration of Pan-pRab, UDD1, UDD2, and 8G10 antibodies to reach 50 ng/µl of slurry (e.g., 12 µg of each antibody for 24 samples in 480 µL slurry).
Add extra 1X PBS to a final volume of 1 mL and incubate at 4 °C for 3 hours on an end-to-end rotator.
Centrifuge at 2000 x g at 4 °C for 2 minutes; collect supernatant for SDS-PAGE confirmation.
Wash the beads 3 times with 1 mL 1X PBS.
Add 1X PBS to a final volume of 480 µL to achieve 50 ng/µl concentration. Store at 4 °C (up to 2 months) or add 0.03% volume sodium azide for longer storage.
Dissolve lyophilized peptides (pRabs and LRRK2) in 100 µL reconstitution buffer (3% vol Acetonitrile in 0.1% vol formic acid in HPLC-grade water) to 10 pmol/µl.
Leave on ice for 20 minutes, then sonicate in a water bath for 5 minutes.
Vortex and centrifuge for 30 seconds.
Prepare dilutions (10 pmol/µl, 1 pmol/µl, 100 fmol/µl, 10 fmol/µl) using reconstitution buffer.
Create an equimolar mixture of all six pRabs and three LRRK2 peptides (e.g., for 1000 fmol/µl in 200 µL total, mix 20 µL of each 10 pmol/µl stock with 40 µL buffer).
Maintain 10 fmol/µl working stocks (stored at -80 °C) so that 10 µL provides 100 fmol.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitation (IP) - First Round
steps.instruction: Perform the first round of immunoprecipitation on the peptide digest.

substeps.instruction: Spin lyophilized peptides at 17000 x g for 2 minutes. Add 1 mL 1X IAP buffer and sonicate in a water bath for 10 minutes.
Adjust pH to ~7.2 using pH strips; if acidic, add 5 µL 1 M Tris pH 12.0.
Centrifuge at high speed for 10 minutes and transfer supernatant to a new 1.5 ml tube; keep on ice.
Add 10 µL antibody slurry (0.5 µg each of Pan-pRab, UDD1, UDD2, 8G10) per 100-150 µg tryptic peptide (recommended >600 µg for brain samples).
Add 100 fmol of equimolar heavy stable peptides (10 µL of 10 fmol/µl stock).
Incubate at 4 °C for 2 hours on an end-to-end rotator.
Centrifuge at 1500 x g at 4 °C for 2 minutes. Collect flow-through for the second round and keep beads on ice.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitation (IP) - Second Round
steps.instruction: Perform the second round of immunoprecipitation on the first round flow-through.

substeps.instruction: Add another 10 µL antibody slurry (0.5 µg each of Pan-pRab, UDD1, UDD2, 8G10) to the flow-through from the first round.
Incubate for 2 hours at 4 °C on an end-to-end rotator.
Centrifuge at 1500 x g at 4 °C for 2 minutes and collect the flow-through.

steps.title: Bead Washing and Elution
steps.instruction: Wash the IP beads and elute the captured peptides.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µL 1X IAP buffer to the beads from the first round, then add another 600 µL 1X IAP buffer and invert 20 times. Centrifuge at 1500 x g at 4 °C for 3 minutes, let settle for 2 minutes, and aspirate.
Wash once with 1 mL ice-cold 1X IAP buffer (centrifuge 1500 x g, 4 °C, 3 min, settle 2 min).
Wash twice with 1 mL ice-cold 1X PBS (centrifuge 1500 x g, 4 °C, 3 min, settle 2 min).
Wash once with 1 mL ice-cold Milli-Q water (centrifuge 1500 x g, 4 °C, 3 min, settle 2 min).
Centrifuge at 1500 x g at room temperature for 2 minutes and collect eluate using a gel loader tip.
Repeat elution by adding 50 µL 0.2% (vol) TFA, incubating at room temperature for 10 minutes, centrifuging, and combining with the previous eluate.

steps.title: C18 Stage-Tip Desalting
steps.instruction: Clean up the acidified peptide digest using a homemade C18 stage-tip.

substeps.instruction: Assemble a C18 stage-tip by punching a C18 layer with a 16-gauge needle and pushing it into a 200 µl tip using a spray duster, staged with a PTFE-O ring in a 1.5 ml tube.
Activate the resin with 80 µL 100% (vol) Acetonitrile; centrifuge at 2000 x g for 2 minutes and discard flow-through.
Equilibrate the resin with 80 µL Solvent-A1 (0.1% vol TFA); centrifuge at 2000 x g for 2 minutes twice and discard flow-through.
Load the acidified peptide digest and centrifuge at 1500 x g for 5 minutes. Reapply the flow-through twice.
Wash twice with 80 µL Solvent-A1 (0.1% vol TFA), centrifuging at 2000 x g for 2 minutes each time and discarding flow-through.

steps.title: Final Peptide Elution and Storage
steps.instruction: Elute the final peptides and store for LC-MS/MS.

substeps.instruction: Transfer stage-tips into new 1.5 ml low-binding tubes.
Add 30 µL Elution buffer (Solvent B1: 50% vol acetonitrile in 0.1% vol TFA), centrifuge at 1500 x g for 2 minutes.
Add another 30 µL Elution buffer and repeat centrifugation at 1500 x g for 2 minutes.
Immediately snap freeze eluates on dry ice and vacuum dry using a Speed-Vac.
Store samples in a -80 °C freezer until LC-MS/MS analysis.
